question: Are the eight attainments of powers identified as the root Kaula teaching?
premises: Eight attainments of powers are enumerated.
These attainments are equated with the root Kaula.
The identification is addressed to the fair-faced goddess.
inference: The eight attainments of powers constitute the root Kaula.
uncertainties: The exact scope of the eight attainments is not specified within this verse alone.
plain_english: And the eight attainments of powers are the root Kaula, O fair-faced one.
